human expect "god" or fantastical animist experiences where it feels like oceans talk to them but the truth is

the ocean is the ocean dude. like it's the thing that does the waves thing

animism isn't imagining some layer on top of that. it's having a relationship with THAT https://t.co/lqSnysHFzS

↓

heck, i can MOCK TALK to a cat, and it *does something*, and i feel the relationship of aliveness with her more vividly. i even begin to experience that relationship verbally

my brain is interpreting the cat (who again, does not speak english) verbally

i might well experience the ocean as sending very clear messages and hear them. but the ocean is still… the ocean

there's a difference between the ocean "speaking english" and my lovely brain experiencing the relationship with the ocean verbally

    Success is usually overdetermined by starting resources and abilities and some degree of luck, but people always attribute it to skill. 
    
    Success is legible but a skilled fight from a bad starting position to a mediocre ending is not legibly distinguishable from an unskilled flop from a great starting position to a  mediocre ending.
    
    Hence the information economy of advice is seriously broken; people can see who is actually winning so they take advice from these people. But these people mostly won for reasons that are not transferrable and often have little to do with the advice they give.
